docs.title: Games & Official Rules
docs.text:
This library implements current official rules. Official sources are limited to exactly two sites:

  • China Welfare Lottery: cwl.gov.cn
  • China Sports Lottery: lottery.gov.cn

Company-operated portals are not used as rule or data sources.

Code Game Operator Pool / Format Official rule source ssq ​双色球​ Welfare 6 red (1-33) + 1 blue (1-16) Game rules qlc ​七乐彩​ Welfare 7 from 30 + special Game rules kl8 ​快乐​8 Welfare 20 drawn from 80, pick 1-10 Game rules 3d ​福彩​3D Welfare 3-digit positional Game rules dlt ​超级​大乐透​ Sports 5 front (1-35) + 2 back (1-12) Game rules (current 7 tiers) pls ​排列​3 Sports 3-digit positional Game rules plw ​排列​5 Sports 5-digit positional Game rules qxc 7​星彩​ Sports 6-digit front (0-9) + last (0-14) Game rules

Rule versions currently implemented are also embedded as *_rule_url attributes in lotterycn/config.py. When rules change, the corresponding tests in tests/test_odds.py must be updated with independently verified combination counts.

docs.title: LotteryCN
docs.text:
A Python library for enjoyable analysis of Chinese welfare & sports lotteries — official draw data, combinatorial odds & expected value, number-picking strategies with backtesting, and winning checks.

Get Started API Reference

Every prize rule, odds table and fixed prize amount in this library is verified against the official game rules published on cwl.gov.cn (China Welfare Lottery) and lottery.gov.cn (China Sports Lottery). See Games & Rules for the complete official source table.

  • Strategies & backtesting (core)

    11 number-picking strategies + a composable shrink engine, with a built-in rolling backtest — every strategy matches random in expected value.

  • Official data only

    Winning numbers and full draw details (sales, prize pools, per-level results, province distribution) — straight from official channels, no third-party scrapers.

  • Combinatorial odds & expectations

    Exact counts for every prize tier; probabilities, expected values and return rates from official prize tables; instant ticket checking.

  • Full pipeline

    Collect (cached incrementally) → analyze → predict → backtest → check.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
from lotterycn import (backtest, backtest_summary, load_history_data,
                       load_number_statistics, load_predict_numbers,
                       load_check_result, load_prize_expectation)

df = load_history_data('ssq', if_cached=True)          # collect (cached, incremental)
stats = load_number_statistics('ssq', history=df)      # analyze
picks = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='hot', amount=5)  # strategy sandbox
print(load_prize_expectation('ssq'))                   # odds & expected value
print(backtest_summary(backtest(methods=('random', 'hot'),
                                lottery_name='ssq', window=100)))

See the API Reference for details.

Honest disclaimer

Lottery draws are independent random events. Historical statistics cannot predict future draws — every strategy in this library has exactly the same expected value as random picking. Everything here is for statistical observation and entertainment. Play rationally (18+).

docs.title: Strategies (for entertainment only)
docs.text:
lotterycn.predict ships eleven number-generation strategies plus a composable filter engine. None of them has any predictive power — draws are independent random events, so every strategy has exactly the same expected value as the random baseline. This module exists for statistical observation and entertainment.

Method Aliases School Idea random — baseline Uniform random — every other strategy should be compared against it frequency hot / cold trend charts Pick numbers by appearance frequency over a sliding window (recent_n), explore_ratio controls determinism omission chase trend charts Mean-reversion chase: score = current omission / average omission ("hot-then-cold" numbers rank highest) deviation chisq statistics Chi-square deviation (observed − expected)² / expected; side='hot' or 'cold' repeat — community Repeat / neighbor (±1) / jump (second-last draw ±1) weighting — the repeat / neighbor / jump-number playbook trend — stock framework Sum moving-average channel: random candidates kept only if their sum falls inside MA ± k·σ tail — trend charts Two-level picks: choose tail digits (number % 10) by frequency, then numbers within those tails markov — sequence First-order transition sampling P(appear now | appeared/not last draw) — collapses to frequency under independence markov2 — sequence Second-order transition (last two draws, 4 states) — shows how higher-order states collapse to uniform through sparsity filter — shape school Composable shrink engine: sum_range, odd_range, prime_range, zone_ratio, mod3_range (012-route), ac_range, consecutive_range, exclude_numbers (kill numbers) ensemble — integration Multi-strategy voting: members each contribute a top-k ticket, numbers ranked by votes (votes_min threshold)

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from lotterycn import load_predict_numbers

picks = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='hot', amount=5)          # alias of frequency + mode='hot'
chase = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='omission', amount=3)     # mean-reversion chase
dev = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='deviation', side='cold', explore_ratio=0)
rep = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='repeat', repeat_weight=3.0)
band = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='trend', k_sigma=1.0)
shrink = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='filter', amount=3,
                              sum_range=(90, 120), prime_range=(2, 3),
                              zone_ratio=(2, 2, 2), exclude_numbers={7, 13})
votes = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='ensemble', amount=1,
                             members=('frequency', 'omission', 'repeat'))

Pass history= to inject a DataFrame and work fully offline; otherwise the factory fetches draw history (respects if_cached=True).

docs.title: Backtesting — verify the "no predictive power" claim yourself
docs.text:
from lotterycn import backtest, backtest_summary

results = backtest(methods=('random', 'hot', 'omission', 'ensemble'),
                   lottery_name='ssq', window=100)
print(backtest_summary(results))

Each strategy is driven by the preceding window draws and evaluated against the next real draw (red/blue hit counts). The expected outcome — reproduced every time — is that all strategies perform on par with random. Community machine-learning attempts (LSTM/XGBoost on number sequences) reach the same conclusion: on a Pick-3-sized space (1/1000) an LSTM lands at ≈ 4.2‰ accuracy, i.e. the baseline. Any "significantly better than random" observation should be treated as overfitting or noise.

docs.title: A note on the stock-analysis analogy
docs.text: Several strategies deliberately mirror stock-analysis frameworks (momentum ≈ hot numbers, mean reversion ≈ omission chase, moving-average channels ≈ trend, volume ≈ sales/pool features from draws.py). The analogy is pedagogical: in an efficient market and in a lottery, frameworks do not create edge — but they make the randomness measurable.

docs.title: backtest — Strategy backtesting
docs.text: Rolling-window backtesting: each strategy is driven by the preceding window draws and scored against the next real draw (red/blue hit counts) — a reproducible experiment that keeps proving every strategy matches the random baseline. backtest_summary aggregates per-strategy averages for the comparison.

docs.title: backtest
docs.text:
​策略​回测​：​滚动​窗口​对比​ random ​基线​。

​预期​结论​：​所有​策略​与​随机​基线​无​差异​

​本​模块​把​ predict.py ​的​免责​声明​变成​一个​可​复现​的​实验​：​滚动​地用​前​ window ​期​历史​驱动​策略​出票​，​与​下​一期​真实​开奖​比​对​命中​个数​。 ​任何​"​显著​优于​随机​"​的​观察​都​应​首先​怀疑​为​过​拟合​或​样本​噪声​。

​用法​： results = backtest(methods=('random', 'frequency'), lottery_name='ssq', window=100) print(backtest_summary(results))

​中奖​校验​：​解析​投注​号码​与​开奖号码​，​输出​命中​情况​、​奖级​与​奖金​。

**​投注​号码​格式​**（​与​ data.py ​历史​开奖​数据​的​ lottery_red / lottery_blue ​列​一致​）：
​彩种​ ​格式​ ​示例​ ssq 6 ​红​ + 1 ​蓝​ '01,05,12,18,27,33\|08' dlt 5 ​前区​ + 2 ​后​区​ '01,05,12,18,27\|03,08' qlc ​仅​ 7 ​个​号码​（​特别​号​不可​自选​） '01,05,12,18,22,27,30' kl8 ​选​ 1-10 ​个​号码​ '01,02,03,04,05' 3d / pls 3 ​位​数字​ '123' ​或​ '1,2,3' plw 5 ​位​数字​ '12345' ​或​ '1,2,3,4,5' qxc 6 ​位前​区​ + ​末位​(0-14) '1,2,3,4,5,6\|14'

​开奖号码​除​字符串​外​，​还​支持​传入​含​ lottery_red / lottery_blue ​字段​的​ dict ​或​ pandas.Series。

load_dlt_compound_expectation(
    n_red: int = 5,
    m_blue: int = 2,
    if_pool_over_800m: bool = False,
    if_add_bet: bool = False,

​返回​大乐透​复式​投注​的​注数​、​成本​与​整票​期望​。

​复式票​选定​ \(n_{red}\) ​个​前区​号码​与​ \(m_{blue}\) ​个​后区​号码​，​组合​为​ \(\binom{n_{red}}{5}\times\binom{m_{blue}}{2}\) ​注​单式​。​开奖​后​前区​命中​ \(r\) ​个​、​后​区​命中​ \(b\) ​个​时​：

\[P(r,b)=\frac{\binom{5}{r}\binom{30}{n_{red}-r}}{\binom{35}{n_{red}}} \times\frac{\binom{2}{b}\binom{10}{m_{blue}-b}}{\binom{12}{m_{blue}}}\] \[\text{i ​等​奖​中奖​注数​}=\sum_{(j,l)\in R_i}\binom{r}{j}\binom{n_{red}-r}{5-j} \binom{b}{l}\binom{m_{blue}-b}{2-l}\] \[\mathbb{E}[\text{​整票​奖金​}]=\sum_{r,b}P(r,b)\cdot\text{Prize}(r,b)\]

​由​期望​的​线性​性​，​整票​期望​恒​等于​ ​总注数​ × ​单式​期望​（​返奖率​不变​）， ​复式​只​改变​成本​与​方差​。

​选​号​策略​集​（​娱乐​与​教学​用途​）。

​仅供​娱乐​，​不​构成​任何​预测​力​

​彩票​开奖​为​独立​随机​事件​，​以下​任何​策略​都​不​具备​真实​预测​力​，​任何​一注​号码​的​ ​中奖​概率​与​随机​选​号​完全相同​。​本​模块​仅​提供​统计​选​号​参考​与​教学​示例​； random ​为​基线​策略​，​任何​策略​都​应先​与​它​对比​（​可用​ lotterycn.backtest ​复现​实验​）。​请​理性​购彩​。

​策略​来源​（​社区​彩票​圈​/​股票​分析​框架​的​平移​，​均​无​真实​预测​力​）： ​随机​基线​ random ​走势图​派​ frequency（​冷热​）、omission（​遗漏​回补​）、tail（​尾数​）、trend（​和​值​均线​通道​） ​形态​派​ filter（​奇偶​/​大小​/​质合​/012​路​/​三区​比​/AC​值​/​连​号​/​杀​号​ ​可​组合​缩水​） ​序列​派​ markov（​一阶​）、markov2（​二阶​，​稀疏​性​教学​）、repeat（​重​号​/​邻号​/​斜​连​号​） ​统计​派​ deviation（​卡方​偏离​度​） ​集成​派​ ensemble（​多​策略​投票​）

​设计​约定​：​策略​类​是​"​纯​注入​"​的​——​构造​器​不​做​任何​网络​ IO，​历史数据​由​ load_predict_numbers ​工厂​统一​解析​并​注入​（​子类​通过​ needs_history ​声明​是否​依赖​历史​，​通过​ aliases ​声明​别名​，​两者​均​由​基类​自动​注册​）。 ​需要​历史数据​的​子类​调用​ self._require_history()。

​本库​实现​的​是​现行​官方​规则​。​官方​来源​仅限​两个​站点​：

docs.title: LotteryCN
docs.text:
​一个​有趣​好玩​的​中国​福利彩票​与​体育彩票​分析​库​——​官方​开奖​数据​、​组合​数学​概率​与​期望​、​选​号​策略​与​预测​回测​、​中奖​校验​。

​快速​上​手​ API ​参考​

​本库​中​每​一个​奖级​、​中奖​条件​与​固定​奖金​，​均​对照​官方​游戏规则​核实​（cwl.gov.cn ​中国​福利彩票​、lottery.gov.cn ​中国​体育彩票​）。

  • ​选​号​策略​与​回测​（​核心​）

    11 ​个​策略​ + ​可​组合​缩水​引擎​，​内置​滚动​回测​——​所有​策略​与​随机​等​期望​。

  • ​只采​官方​数据​

    ​中奖号码​与​开奖​详情​（​销售额​ / ​奖池​ / ​各奖级​中奖​情况​ / ​省级​分布​）​直接​来自​官方​渠道​——​无​第三方​爬虫​。

  • ​组合​数学​的​概率​与​期望​

    ​精确​组合​计数​各奖级​命中​数​；​概率​、​期望​、​返奖率​由​官方​奖金​表​推导​；​支持​投注​号码​即时​校验​。

  • ​完整​流水线​

    ​收集​（​增量​缓存​）→ ​分析​ → ​预测​ → ​回测​ → ​校验​。

docs.title: 快速​上​手
docs.text:
from lotterycn import (backtest, backtest_summary, load_history_data,
                       load_number_statistics, load_predict_numbers,
                       load_check_result, load_prize_expectation)

df = load_history_data('ssq', if_cached=True)          # ​收集​（​缓存​增量​）
stats = load_number_statistics('ssq', history=df)      # ​分析​
picks = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='hot', amount=5)  # ​策略​沙盒​
print(load_prize_expectation('ssq'))                   # ​概率​与​期望​
print(backtest_summary(backtest(methods=('random', 'hot'),
                                lottery_name='ssq', window=100)))

​详见​ API ​参考​。

​诚实​声明​

​彩票​开奖​是​独立​随机​事件​。​历史​统计​无法​预测​未来​开奖​——​本库​任何​策略​的​期望​ ​收益​都​与​随机​选​号​完全相同​。​一切​内容​仅​用于​统计​观察​与​娱乐​。​请​理性​购彩​（18+）。

docs.title: 策略​（​仅供​娱乐​）
docs.text:
lotterycn.predict ​内置​ 11 ​个​选号​策略​与​ 1 ​个​可​组合​缩水​引擎​。​它们​都​不​具备​任何​预测​力​——​开奖​是​独立​随机​事件​，​所有​策略​的​期望​收益​与​ random ​基线​完全相同​。​本​模块​仅​用于​统计​观察​与​娱乐​。

​策略​ ​别名​ ​流派​ ​思路​ random — ​基线​ ​均匀​随机​——​一切​策略​的​对照​ frequency hot / cold ​走势图​ ​滑动​窗口​（recent_n）​频率​选​号​，explore_ratio ​控制​确定性​ omission chase ​走势图​ ​遗漏​回补​：​当前​遗漏​ / ​平均​遗漏​，"​热后​转冷​"​排​最前​ deviation chisq ​统计​ ​卡方​偏离​度​（​实际​-​期望​)²/​期望​；side='hot' ​或​ 'cold' repeat — ​社区​ ​重​号​ / ​邻号​(±1) / ​斜​连​号​（​上​上期​±1）​三​权重​打分​ trend — ​股票​框架​ ​和​值​均线​通道​：​候选​和​值​落入​ MA ± k·σ ​才​保留​ tail — ​走势图​ ​两级​选​号​：​先​按​尾数​（​号码​%10）​频率​选尾​，​再尾​内取​号​ markov — ​序列​ ​一阶​转移​采样​ P(​本期​出现​|​上期​出现​/​未​出现​)——​独立​下​退化​为​频率​ markov2 — ​序列​ ​二阶​转移​（​上​两期​ 4 ​态​）——​展示​高阶​状态​稀疏​后​退化​均匀​ filter — ​形态​ ​可​组合​缩水​：​和​值​ / ​奇偶​ / ​质合​ / ​三区​比​ / 012 ​路​ / AC ​值​ / ​连​号​ / ​杀​号​ ensemble — ​集成​ ​多​策略​投票​：​成员​各出​ top-k，​按​号码​得票​排序​（votes_min ​阈值​）

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
from lotterycn import load_predict_numbers

picks = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='hot', amount=5)          # frequency + mode='hot'
chase = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='omission', amount=3)     # ​遗漏​回补​
dev = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='deviation', side='cold', explore_ratio=0)
shrink = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='filter', amount=3,
                              sum_range=(90, 120), prime_range=(2, 3),
                              zone_ratio=(2, 2, 2), exclude_numbers={7, 13})
votes = load_predict_numbers('ssq', method='ensemble', amount=1,
                             members=('frequency', 'omission', 'repeat'))

​传​ history= ​注入​ DataFrame ​可​完全​离线​；​否则​工厂​拉取​历史​（​支持​ if_cached=True）。

docs.title: 回测​——​亲自​验证​"​无​预测​力​"
docs.text:
from lotterycn import backtest, backtest_summary

results = backtest(methods=('random', 'hot', 'omission', 'ensemble'),
                   lottery_name='ssq', window=100)
print(backtest_summary(results))

​每个​策略​由前​ window ​期​历史​驱动​出票​，​与​下​一期​真实​开奖​比​对​红​/​蓝​命中​数​。​每次​复现​的​结论​都​一样​：​所有​策略​与​ random ​表现​相当​。​社区​机器​学习​尝试​（LSTM/XGBoost ​预测​号码​序列​）​结论​一致​：​排列三​量级​（1/1000）​空间​上​ LSTM ​准确率​ ≈ 4.2‰，​即​基线​水平​。​任何​"​显著​优于​随机​"​的​观察​都​应​视为​过​拟合​或​噪声​。

docs.title: 关于​股票​分析​类比
docs.text: ​部分​策略​刻意​沿用​了​股票​分析​框架​（​动量​ ≈ ​追热​、​均值​回归​ ≈ ​遗漏​回补​、​均线​通道​ ≈ trend、​量​ ≈ draws.py ​的​销售​/​奖池​特征​）。​类比​是​教学​性​的​：​在​有效​市场​和​彩票​里​，​框架​都​不​创造​优势​——​但​它们​让​随机性​变得​可​度量​。

docs.title: analysis — ​号码​统计分析
docs.text: ​每个​号码​的​出现​次数​、​频率​、​当前​遗漏​、​最大​遗漏​与​平均​遗漏​。

docs.title: backtest — ​策略​回测
docs.text: ​滚动​窗口​回测​：​用前​ window ​期​历史​驱动​各​策略​出票​，​与​下​一期​真实​开奖​比​对​命中​数​——​把​ predict.py ​的​免责​声明​变成​可​复现​的​实验​，​反复证明​所有​策略​与​ random ​基线​无​差异​； backtest_summary ​汇总​各​策略​的​平均​命中​供​对比​。

docs.title: cache — ​本地​缓存
docs.text: CSV ​缓存​与​增量​更新​：​首次​全量​拉取​落盘​，​之后​仅拉取​最后​开奖​日期​之后​的​数据​。

docs.text: ​解析​投注​号码​与​开奖号码​，​输出​命中​情况​、​奖级​与​奖金​。

docs.text: ​安装​后​提供​ lotterycn ​控制台​命令​（​等价​ python -m lotterycn.cli）。

docs.title: data — ​官方​开奖​数据
docs.text: ​从​ cwl.gov.cn ​与​ lottery.gov.cn ​官方网站​拉取​ 8 ​个彩种​的​历史​开奖​数据​，​输出​统一​格式​的​ pandas.DataFrame。

docs.title: draws — ​开奖​详情
docs.text: ​官方​开奖​公告​的​完整​字​段​：​销售额​、​奖池​、​各奖级​中奖​注数​与​单注​奖金​、​一等奖​省级​分布​，​输出​三张​ tidy ​表并​支持​增量​缓存​。

docs.title: odds — ​中奖​概率​与​奖金​期望
docs.text: ​基于​官方​规则​的​精确​组合​数学​：​各奖级​中奖​组合​数​、​概率​、​单注​期望​奖金​与​返​奖率​；​含​大乐透​追加​/​复式​口径​。

docs.title: predict — ​选​号​策略​集
docs.text:
